visa_steps.what: French citizens aged 18 to 30 when applying, with a valid passport, who have never had a New Zealand working holiday visa.

visa_steps.step: 2. Apply online with Immigration New Zealand
visa_steps.what: Fee from NZ$770 (check before paying). Up to 12 months in New Zealand: holidays, temporary work, and up to 6 months of study or training.
visa_steps.when: Any time now: we must arrive within 12 months of approval, so any approval from now on covers landing on 1 August 2027

visa_steps.step: 3. Show money and a way out
visa_steps.what: At least NZ$4,200 each for living costs, plus an onward ticket or the money to buy one.
visa_steps.when: With the application; carry proof on arrival

visa_steps.step: 4. Medical insurance for the whole stay
visa_steps.what: Full medical insurance including hospital stays; INZ may ask for a certificate or letter from the insurer. Our notes say Chapka covers tourist travel only; AVA Pass has a PVT rate (€40/month, €160 minimum).
visa_steps.when: Before applying: see the Insurance tab

visa_steps.what: INZ may ask for a chest X-ray or medical exam, or police certificates less than 6 months old.

job_types.where: Central Auckland (CBD, Britomart, Ponsonby, Mt Eden), Waiheke at weekends
job_types.season: All year; winter is quieter, so start handing out CVs in the first days
job_types.pay: At least NZ$23.95/h; front-of-house listings seen at NZ$24–26/h plus 8% holiday pay
job_types.how: Seek, Trade Me Jobs, Backpacker Job Board, walking in with a CV
job_types.note: Barista experience helps a lot. Tips are small in New Zealand

job_types.where: Pukekohe, Waiuku and Ardmore, about 50 km south of the city
job_types.season: From June for about 12 weeks, so August is the end of the season
job_types.pay: Hourly or per vine, never below the minimum wage
job_types.how: Pick NZ, Work and Income seasonal calendar, Find a Job (MSD)
job_types.note: Needs our own transport, early starts, cold and wet days

job_types.where: Waiheke Island (maintenance and thinning); winter pruning is mostly in Marlborough and Central Otago
job_types.how: Pick NZ, vineyards' own careers pages, Backpacker Board
job_types.note: Waiheke jobs ask you to live on the island (ferry from Auckland)

job_types.where: All over Auckland; warehouse and forklift work mostly in South Auckland
job_types.pay: Shown for each shift in the app, plus 8% holiday pay; forklift listings seen at NZ$26–28/h
job_types.how: Sidekicker app (2-minute sign-up), temp and labour-hire agencies (Backpacker Board lists them), Seek
job_types.note: Good for the first weeks while looking for a steady job

job_types.where: Hostels in Auckland, farms and homestays around it
job_types.pay: A bed and often meals instead of wages, for a few hours a day
job_types.how: WWOOF NZ (NZ$40 for the first 14 months, then NZ$20 to renew), HelpX, hostel notice boards
job_types.note: Counts as work: it needs the working holiday visa even without wages

job_types.job: Queenstown in September (after the road trip)
job_types.season: Ski season until about early October; most ski-field hiring happens months before
job_types.how: Seek, Backpacker Job Board, walking in
job_types.note: Late in the season: hospitality in town is more likely than a ski-field job
